verified_facts.text: The resort is in Canyons Village, with ski-in, gondola-out access to Park City Mountain in winter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape to a refined retreat in Canyons Village, where scenic trails give way to ski-in, gondola-out access to Park City Mountain come winter.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Frostwood Gondola for skiing Park City Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: This winter, wake up just steps from the Frostwood Gondola to ski Park City Mountain with seamless ski-in access

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a complimentary shuttle to Deer Valley Resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: or hop aboard our complimentary shuttle to discover Deer Valley Resort.

verified_facts.text: Every room, suite and residence has its own fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each accommodation is anchored by its own fireplace.

verified_facts.text: Many accommodations include furnished balconies, soaking tubs and full kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many include furnished balconies, soaking tubs, and full kitchens.

verified_facts.text: Bi-level residences have an upstairs primary bedroom overlooking a living room with mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bi-level residences feature an upstairs primary bedroom overlooking a generous living room framed by mountain views.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a year-round heated pool and hot tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: complemented by a year-round heated pool and hot tubs

verified_facts.text: Dining is modern alpine cuisine made from seasonal ingredients, with artisanal cocktails, curated wines and locally distilled spirits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor modern alpine cuisine artfully crafted from seasonal ingredients, complemented by artisanal cocktails, curated wines, and locally distilled spirits.

verified_facts.text: Curated outdoor pursuits in the Wasatch Mountains include hiking, fly-fishing and mountain biking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reconnect with the natural world through thoughtfully curated outdoor pursuits designed to immerse you in the beauty of the majestic Wasatch Mountains.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was formerly the Dakota Mountain Lodge, at the base of Canyons Resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: formerly the Dakota Mountain Lodge, at the base of Canyons Resort

verified_facts.text: Rooms in natural colors have custom furnishings and views of the ski slopes and Wasatch Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautiful rooms in natural colors have custom furnishings and views of the ski slopes and Wasatch Mountains.

verified_facts.text: An outdoor patio has fire pits near the heated pool and whirlpools.
verified_facts.excerpt: relax on the outdoor patio near the fire pits, heated pool, and whirlpools

verified_facts.text: Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out at 11:00 AM.
verified_facts.excerpt: Check-in **4:00 PM**

verified_facts.text: Event venues framed by the Wasatch Mountains host meetings and celebrations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our venues, framed by the Wasatch Mountains, are designed to host unforgettable meetings and celebrations led by an experienced team.

verified_facts.text: Powder, the hotel restaurant, was named Forbes Recommended in the 2026 Star Awards.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are also delighted to share that Powder has been recognized as Forbes Recommended

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers named it the No. 1 Resort in the Mountain West and No. 4 Resort in the World in the 2025 Readers' Choice Awards.
verified_facts.excerpt: recognized as the No. 1 Resort in the Mountain West and No. 4 Resort in the World in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers’ Choice Awards 2025

verified_facts.text: The resort is dog-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a proud dog-friendly resort, we ensure every member of the family feels right at home.

verified_facts.text: Guided snowshoeing is offered to in-house guests, with equipment provided, for ages 12 and up.
verified_facts.excerpt: In house guests are invited on a guided, two and a half hour, wintry exploration through breathtaking alpine landscapes.

verified_facts.text: Powder serves a Grab & Gondola breakfast menu of pastries, breakfast bites and coffee for skiers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your morning with our Grab & Gondola menu at Powder

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Aescape, a fully automated AI-powered massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: the world’s first fully automated AI-powered massage experience, now at the Waldorf Astoria Park City Spa

verified_facts.text: Premium e-bikes can be rented on-site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rent premium E-bikes conveniently on-site
